initialize_model_parallelism: initialize model parallelism with world size, local rank, GPU device, and random seed
get_world_size: get the world size of the initialized model parallel process group
get_rank: get the local rank of the current process in the model parallel group
all_gather_tensors: all-gather tensors across all model parallel processes and concatenate along the last dimension
all_reduce_tensors: all-reduce tensors across all model parallel processes using sum reduction
